properties.site-address: Site 2 - Spittal Point, Sandstell Road, Spittal
properties.notes: Potential opportunity for extensive redevelopment of existing industrial and commercial land. A number of proposals relate to the site. Development of 136 units has been consented (N/09/B/0317). However delivery of this scheme is currently considered uncertain as there is no evidence of progress to date or implementation of planning permission. Another application for 136 dwellings and supporting commercial space remains pending despite being submitted some time ago (12/00512/FUL). Given the long planning history, deliverability of site is uncertain in the immediate future but longer-term potential is still considered to remain. The extant planning permission includes consent for 323m2 of commercial use, alongside public open space and a car park.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
